title: Sandwich Topology: Redis vs Postgres JSONB Session Store
prompt: /rounds 1 Should we migrate our multi-tenant session store from Redis to Postgres JSONB for 20k concurrent users?
evaluation_notes: Visionary should frame strategic tradeoffs, middle pool should critique/explore alternatives, and Security Architect should synthesize security and operational takeaways.

title: Scatter-Gather Parallel Dialectic: Multi-Region Failover
prompt: Design a multi-region active-active database failover strategy with RPO < 5 seconds and RTO < 30 seconds.
evaluation_notes: Parallel branches (Innovator, Sceptic) should surface distinct angles without parroting one another, and Security Architect should gather and reconcile them.

title: Fixed Chain: EU AI SaaS Tier Economics & GDPR
prompt: /[ROIStrategist] /[LegalAdvisor] /max_words 110 Evaluate launching an EU-hosted AI SaaS tier covering unit economics and GDPR data residency risks.
evaluation_notes: Both agents must stay concise (~110 words max + grace buffer) and maintain strict domain separation between financial ROI and EU GDPR compliance.

title: Document-Grounded Debate: PaymentLedger Spec Review

staged_files.eval_architecture_spec.txt:
Service: PaymentLedger API
Target Latency: p99 < 40ms
Encryption at Rest: AES-256-GCM with 90-day KMS key rotation
Audit Log Retention: 90-day hot retention in WAL SQLite
Throughput Baseline: 4200 req/s

prompt: /[SecurityArchitect] /[Sceptic] Read eval_architecture_spec.txt and assess whether the latency, encryption, and retention targets are mutually consistent.
evaluation_notes: Agents must read the staged file eval_architecture_spec.txt and ground their analysis accurately in p99 < 40ms, AES-256-GCM, and 90-day retention.

title: Convergence Stress-Test Gate: Challenger & Arbitrator
prompt: /rounds 2 Propose migrating our internal nightly reporting batch job to SQLite WAL mode. If agents agree on the approach, converge cleanly by calling signal_consensus_convergence.
evaluation_notes: Should demonstrate convergence or rigorous stress-testing of assumptions (write concurrency, backup/retention) before final synthesis.
